senses.gloss: chidrāchidra (nt.; 〔§ 23.12〕), all manner of holes: (na svapet) chidrāchidreṣu sattvānāṃ yac ca sthānaṃ mahadbhayam (Śikṣ mahābh˚) Laṅk 〔257.1〕, cited Śikṣ 〔132.7〕 (one should not sleep) in all manner of holes of creatures (animals), and (not in) whatever is a place of great danger. Both translations are incorrect.
chidrīkaraṇa (nt.; to next), in a-cchid˚, the (not) making defective: ˚raṇāvipādanatayā (i.e. -avipād˚) Bbh 〔187.14〕.
chidrīkaroti (cf. prec. and next; to Skt. chidra with kṛ-), makes defective: -samādānaṃ na chidrīkaroti (bodhisattvaḥ) Bbh 〔183.24〕.
chidrīkāra (m.; to prec.) = ˚karaṇa; in cpd., Bbh 〔162.19〕.
